In other words, a time clock = a strategic tool that directly impacts organizational profitability and success. The top choice for attendance tracking – Biometric time clock Biometric time clocks are the most widely used solution, with fingerprint-based clocks being the top choice in terms of demand and sales. But what makes them the preferred choice for so many businesses? Fingerprint time clocks combine precision, reliability, and affordability; It is based on a technology similar to the fingerprint sensors on smartphones, and ensure that employees can only clock in and out themselves, effectively eliminating “buddy punching.” Compared to other biometric options, such as facial recognition, PIN codes, or proximity cards, fingerprint clocks offer a more cost-efficient solution – making them an ideal choice for factories, warehouses, and offices with fixed work locations. Read more about biometric time clock Do you have field workers? Employees who are not constantly on-site – such as technicians, sales representatives, drivers, or hybrid workers – cannot rely solely on a physical time clock. Meckano offers two solutions to manage attendance for these teams: Time tracking app Enables employees to quickly clock in and out from any location, with GPS-based verification and configurable attendance zones. Designed for remote workforces, it ensures accurate and reliable data in all work environments. Allows logging of working hours via a short dial to a dedicated number, accessible from any mobile or landline. How do You determine the optimal solution for your business? Define your needs – What are the unique characteristics of your business? (the “who” and “where”) How many employees are in your organization? Small businesses (up to 15 employees): A time tracking app or a tablet-based time clock (kiosk) is usually a cost-effective and sufficient solution. Medium businesses (50–100 employees): A combination of attendance solutions is typically required to accommodate both field and office employees (for example, using both a biometric time clock and a time tracking app). Large businesses (101+ employees): Multiple attendance solutions are needed to cover all operational requirements and ensure flexibility for diverse teams. Office, field, or hybrid? Office (Fixed Location): A physical time clock—biometric or tablet—installed at the entrance provides precise time tracking and complete oversight of employee attendance. Field: A GPS-based time tracking app allows for clocking in and out from any location, offering maximum flexibility and reliability. Field workers without internet access can clock in and out via phone-based reporting. Remote or hybrid: A time-tracking app or web-based clock allows employees to clock in from anywhere.
